Base Coaching

Self-Directed Training

Get a personalized 8-12 week program with regular updates. Best for experienced athletes who prefer independence.

Right For You If...

  • You're an experienced athlete who enjoys taking the lead on your own training
  • You prefer hands-on coaching over micromanagement
  • You want the freedom to adjust your training schedule to fit your life
  • You have a solid understanding of exercise and training principles
  • You're self-motivated and disciplined with your workouts

Not For You If...

  • You need weekly hands-on coaching and accountability
  • You're new to training and need foundational guidance
  • You prefer daily check-ins and direct supervision

Benefit Overview

Base Coaching gives you the freedom to train at your own pace while receiving expert guidance and accountability. This option is perfect for athletes who want the structure and expertise of professional coaching without the daily micromanagement.

Expert Programming

You get a comprehensive, science-based training plan designed specifically for your sport, goals, and current fitness level.

Regular Updates

Stay on track with 3-4 program updates per cycle to adjust for progress, fatigue, or new information.

Flexibility

Train on your schedule. We provide the plan; you execute it with the freedom that comes with experience.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a program last?

Base Coaching programs are typically 8 weeks, but can extend to 12 weeks based on your goals and progress. Programs are periodized to maximize results while managing fatigue and recovery.

How often do I get updates?

You'll receive 3-4 program updates per cycle. These updates help adjust your training based on your progress, any injuries or changes, and new information about your performance.

What if I don't have the right equipment?

No problem! My programs are designed to work with whatever equipment you have access to. I'll help you set up a program using home gym equipment, minimal equipment, or even bodyweight exercises.

Can I combine Base Coaching with Premium Coaching?

Yes! Many athletes mix Base and Premium Coaching depending on their needs at different times. For example, you might use Premium for technique refinement and Base for the main training program.

What if I need to pause training due to travel or injury?

We can pause your program at any time. When you're ready to continue, we'll review your progress and adjust the program accordingly. This flexibility is part of why many athletes choose Base Coaching.
